components.name: Lime Button
components.css: .ds-button-lime { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:14px 24px; border:0; border-radius:var(--control-radius, 4px); background:var(--lime, #e1ff67); color:var(--navy, #0b1736); font:650 16px/1.4 "Inter Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), background-color 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); } .ds-button-lime:hover { background:#d6f456; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-lime:active { transform:translateY(0) scale(.98); } .ds-button-lime:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2e6f94; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Navy Button
components.css: .ds-button-navy { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:14px 24px; border:0; border-radius:var(--control-radius, 4px); background:var(--navy, #0b1736); color:#fff; font:650 16px/1.4 "Inter Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), background-color 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); } .ds-button-navy:hover { background:#1b3556; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-navy:active { transform:translateY(0) scale(.98); } .ds-button-navy:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2e6f94; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:11px 18px; border:0; border-radius:var(--control-radius, 4px); background:var(--surface, #eef3f6); color:var(--navy, #0b1736); font:650 13px/1.4 "Inter Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), background-color 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); } .ds-button-quiet:hover { background:var(--surface-strong, #e1eaf0); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-quiet:active { transform:translateY(0) scale(.98); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2e6f94; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Persistent label, bordered field and explicit focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-collection">Collection location</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-collection" placeholder="City, country" />
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--navy, #0b1736); font:650 13px/1.5 "Inter Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-input { width:100%; height:52px; padding:0 14px; color:var(--navy, #0b1736); background:#fff; border:1px solid #8191a6; border-radius:var(--control-radius, 4px); font:16px "Inter Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#526078; opacity:1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--navy, #0b1736); } .ds-input:focus { outline:3px solid #2e6f94; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border:2px solid var(--error, #a01d31); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Desktop navigation text with a touch-sized hit area.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--navy, #0b1736); text-decoration:none; font:600 13px "Inter Variable",sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:#2b617c; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2e6f94; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Service Action
components.description: Flat, square service choice with a visible action label.
components.css: .ds-service { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; text-align:left; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:24px 28px; color:var(--navy, #0b1736); background:var(--surface, #eef3f6); font-family:"Inter Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); } .ds-service strong { font-size:24px; line-height:1.2; font-weight:750; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-service p { font-size:16px; line-height:1.6; margin:0; max-width:45ch; } .ds-service span { font-size:13px; font-weight:650; line-height:1.5; margin-top:8px; } .ds-service:hover { background:var(--surface-strong, #e1eaf0); } .ds-service:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2e6f94; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Selected Region Tab
components.description: Selected region control inside the dark route board.
components.css: .ds-region { padding:12px 18px; min-height:48px; border:0; border-radius:var(--control-radius, 4px); color:var(--navy, #0b1736); background:var(--lime, #e1ff67); font:550 16px "Inter Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-region:hover { background:var(--lime, #e1ff67); } .ds-region:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--lime, #e1ff67); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive reading of the implemented interface, grounded in
`src/style.css`, `src/sections.js` and `src/main.js`. It is not a new brand proposal.
Dark blue, lime, heavy Inter and port photography retain the user-selected identity.
Broad type, clear origin/destination pairs and explicit action labels make shipment
information easy to scan.

The page alternates open white content with dark route/review surfaces and a lime
enquiry close. Photographs carry the logistics setting; typography and spacing
carry the hierarchy. `PRODUCT.md` records the durable constraints; homepage-specific
composition belongs to `.impeccable/surfaces/home.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, square content panels and subtly rounded controls.
Port photography and an unboxed route board.
Clear English actions and visibly labelled demonstration content.

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use the light-surface and dark-surface text pairings already present; retain explicit field errors and keyboard focus indicators.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Preserve Inter's heavy display and restrained body hierarchy when extending this selected identity.

dos: **Do** preserve the selected dark-blue/lime identity and heavy Inter hierarchy.
**Do** keep action labels, keyboard focus and field labels visible.
**Do** reuse the existing flat surface and responsive spacing relationships.
**Do** retain demo labels and the local-only enquiry disclosure.
donts: **Don't** replace the selected identity as a side effect of a detector warning.
**Don't** turn every list, route row and paragraph group into an elevated card.
**Don't** present generated imagery or fictional figures and reviews as verified proof.
